lifestyle.home: 3 bedroom house, yacht, or any two (10)
Private island, palace (100) or any three

alternateIdentity.label: Alternate identity
alternateIdentity.notes: Changing identity takes 2 full rounds; checks to see through it have +10 DC. Alternate form is unavailable.

aquatic.label: Aquatic
aquatic.notes: Move at standard Speed underwater; cannot drown; ignore underwater penalties.

augmented.label: Augmented (Caliber I)
augmented.notes: Choose an installed Caliber I item or weapon. It is always proficient, readies as a free action and cannot be disarmed. Record the chosen item in Gear.

burrow.label: Burrow
burrow.notes: Tunnel through material with a 1-inch Damage save bonus no greater than half STR (rounded up). Cannot Run while burrowing.

camouflaged.label: Camouflaged (one terrain)
camouflaged.notes: Choose a terrain: aquatic, arctic, desert, forest, jungle, mountain, plains or swamp. In it, +4 to Blend/Stealth and Sneak/Hide. Record the terrain in the details.

damageReduction.label: Damage reduction (2)
damageReduction.notes: Natural DR 2; not cumulative with an identical gear or class-ability benefit.

damageResistance.label: Damage resistance (4)
damageResistance.notes: Choose a damage type; resistance 4 against that type. Record the type in the details.

fastHealing.label: Fast healing
fastHealing.notes: Heal every damage type at twice its standard rate.

fearless.label: Fearless I
fearless.notes: +4 to Resolve/Morale checks; this is not a general Will-save bonus.

fleet.label: Fleet (+10 ft.)
fleet.notes: Speed increases by 10 ft. per application, maximum 60 ft.; does not combine with identical gear or class benefits (pp.446–447).

hulking.label: Hulking (Large, 1×1)
hulking.notes: Large Size: −1 Defense and attack checks, −4 Blend/Stealth and Sneak/Hide, wounds 1.5×CON (round down), carrying limits ×2, Reach 2 squares; footprint 1×1.

improvedHearing.label: Improved hearing
improvedHearing.notes: Hearing range WIS×10 ft.; unless deafened, +6 Notice/Awareness and Search/Perception when determining surprise.

improvedScent.label: Improved scent
improvedScent.notes: Scent range WIS×10 ft.; +6 Survival/Tracking when scent can be used.

improvedVision.label: Improved vision
improvedVision.notes: Visual range WIS×20 ft.; unless blinded, reduce each attack range penalty by 2, to a minimum penalty of 0.

lowLightVision.label: Low-light vision
lowLightVision.notes: Ignore vision penalties from dawn, dusk and night.

naturalAttack.label: Natural attack (Caliber II)
naturalAttack.notes: Choose a Caliber II natural attack from Table 7.12 (p.449). Always proficient; readies freely and cannot be disarmed. Record the chosen attack in Gear.

seductive.label: Seductive
seductive.notes: +4 to skill checks that shift disposition and checks in a seduction Dramatic Conflict.

strongMinded.label: Strong-minded I
strongMinded.notes: +4 to Resist skill checks; this is not a general Will-save bonus.

unnerving.label: Unnerving I
unnerving.notes: Each damaging unarmed or melee attack also inflicts 1d4 stress damage.
